cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.desc: On hit, deal 45% damage to a nearby foe.

lifesteal.name: Bloodthirst
lifesteal.desc: Heal for 18% of damage dealt on hit.

burn.name: Immolate
burn.desc: Hits ignite the foe for bonus fire damage over time.

firstStrike.name: First Strike
firstStrike.desc: Your opening blow each fight deals +50% damage.

chain.name: Arc Chain
chain.desc: Ranged/magic hits have a 40% chance to arc to a second foe.

manaFont.name: Mana Font
manaFont.desc: 15% chance on hit to restore a spell slot.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.desc: When hit in melee, retaliate for 3 + half level damage.

phaseStep.name: Phase Step
phaseStep.desc: On kill, gain +4 AC for 1 round.

keenEdge.name: Keen Edge
keenEdge.desc: Widen critical range by 1 (stacks with other sources).
